publishedMetadata.title: Bug Hunt mismatched form state
publishedMetadata.description: Find and remove duplicated form state, stale previews, and uncontrolled-to-controlled mismatches. This guided lab analyzes and repairs a real React Hook Form state or submission failure.
objectives: Find and remove duplicated form state, stale previews, and uncontrolled-to-controlled mismatches.
Type, reset and programmatically update the field; preview and submitted payload must be consistent, with no independent useState shadow.
Treat displayed form previews as user content; React text interpolation escapes text, while innerHTML would introduce an XSS risk.
rubric: Find and remove duplicated form state, stale previews, and uncontrolled-to-controlled mismatches.
Type, reset and programmatically update the field; preview and submitted payload must be consistent, with no independent useState shadow.
I can explain why client validation is not server authorization.

blockedOn: Run genuine nested npm ci and actual React Hook Form/Chromium positive and negative checks
Pass published Next MDX route/build and local lab acceptance on exact candidate
Record actual reviewer, screen reader, keyboard and 200% zoom evidence
